notes.title: Added Doomsday Mystery Box and new events
notes.content:
Thank you for your valuable messages and comments. We have read every message. This time we have updated some new content. The game is still being improved. thank you for your support.
The update content is as follows:
1 Supplementary activities after 50 days
2 Added various types of “Doomsday Blind Boxes”
3 Added exclusive skills for flight attendants and female bosses
4 Reset skill points
5 Partially Stuck Errors

notes.title: Fixed crashes, patched some plots, and some rewards.
notes.content:
1. Fixed some crashes and crashes
2. Added the possibility of the Doctor exiting the plot midway through the ending.
3. Repair part where no reward props are given
4. Optimize the button to skip the plot
5. Fixed the problem of not taking effect when giving food at night

notes.title: "Doomsday Love Shelter" is officially launched!
notes.content: Thank you for your attention. "Doomsday Love Shelter" will be officially launched on March 24, 2024. I hope it can bring you a little happiness.

notes.title: "Apocalypse Love Shelter" is scheduled to be released on March 24, Beijing time
notes.content: Is this apocalyptic survival? Or is love developing? It's up to you who gets access to the shelter. The official version of "Doomsday Love Shelter" is scheduled to be released on March 24, Beijing time

notes.title: 《Apocalypse Love Shelter 》coming soon!
notes.content:
[b]Different from any doomsday survival, and also different from any real-person simulation[/b]
New game "Apocalypse Love Shelter" will be released soon
A brand new real-person interactive love simulation + business simulation + doomsday survival.
Allocate limited water to your members,
You can run a shelter, go out to find supplies, and start special events at night.
Various branches and endings are waiting for you to open.
Do please look forward to!
